description: This PHP script is part of the SuiteCRM project, specifically in the UpgradeWizard module. It handles uploading and checking the size of a specified file, decoding JSON requests, and performing some validation such as preventing certain file schemes and size limits.

methods.name: require_once
methods.description: Includes external PHP files necessary for JSON handling and file upload processing.

methods.name: getJSONobj
methods.description: Creates and returns a JSON object used for decoding JSON data.

methods.name: return_bytes
methods.description: Converts a PHP ini size string (like '2M') into an integer number of bytes.

methods.name: sugar_cleanup
methods.description: Performs cleanup activities for SuiteCRM after script execution.
